outcome: Effectiveness of antibiotic prophylaxis (implied by comparable outcomes and conclusion)
cohort: Women undergoing elective caesarean section at a hospital in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India.
finding: Single-dose antibiotic prophylaxis was found to be as effective as conventional multi-dose antibiotic therapy, additionally offering benefits in cost-effectiveness, preventing antibiotic resistance, reducing patient side effects, and lessening nursing staff work.
